scope: risk/1.1, part 2: beta, R-squared, Jensen's alpha, active return, benchmark return, tracking error, information ratio; the benchmark contract and its currency translation at the portfolio's ECB fixing; total return required (a price-return series refused); the selection log; comparability FULL, SEAM (by calendar and by the ECB fixing alone) and LAGGED; a BANK_DISCOUNT risk-free series; the unavailable-benchmark HG3 edge case in all four forms (no selection or cleared, series missing, price return, not covering the window); cash-only against a benchmark; metamorphic #6 (benchmark identical to the portfolio) and #7 (constant rate).
change_notes: 1.0-part2 (2026-10-02): first issue, authored and ratified by quant-analyst. Every expected value is hand-derived (CP4_GOLDEN_PART2_DERIVATION.md: four-week cycle sums for Q1, Q2-T1 and Q4; period arithmetic for every window fact; every state case) and re-derived from this file's inputs by derivation/cp4_part2_calculator.py (standard library only; reuses the part-1 calculator for valuation; imports nothing from src/). Every item names the mutations that must fail it ('bites'); --mutations verifies each mutation changes exactly those items. No value comes from the engine. convention_sets are MINIMUM versions (risk Ruling 11.4).

convention_sets.lot_relief: FIFO/1 (no assertion in part 2 depends on it)

format.inherits: Every rule of cp4_golden/1.0-part1 'format' applies (request, requested_base, effective_window, value, exact, exact_square/sign, thresholds, details_include, reason, rates, stale_period_count, tolerance).
format.selection_log_version: Per assertion: the version of the portfolio's selection log the caller pins (risk Ruling 5.6 (1.1)): records with seq <= version are in force, the latest wins; 0 = none.
format.benchmark_selections: Per portfolio: the append-only selection log {seq, selection_id, portfolio_id, benchmark_id (null = cleared), recorded_at} (migration 0015's content).
format.benchmark_expected: Per assertion (the selection is per assertion): the benchmark lineage every benchmark-dependent item (the two-leg kinds and benchmark_return) must carry: {benchmark_id, selection_id} always (null when none is in force), plus return_basis, currency and currency_treatment when the series exists (risk Ruling 5.6).
format.comparability: Two-leg items (beta, r_squared, alpha_jensen, tracking_error, information_ratio, active_return): the object of risk Ruling 8.3 (1.1) {class FULL|LIMITED, seam null|{portfolio_calendars, benchmark_calendars, max_offset_minutes_at_last_grid_date}, lagged {count, of, points}}; null when the item is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
format.v_beta: beta items: the exact OLS sampling variance of beta, (S_rr - beta S_rb) / ((n - 2) S_bb) (risk Ruling 6.7), lineage only.
format.decomposition_view: active_return items: the apportioned triple {portfolio_twr, benchmark_return, active_return} of risk Ruling 6.9 (1.1); it may differ from 'value' by one quantum, and does in Q1-B1 and Q5-H1.
format.bites: The ids of the mutations (mutation_catalog) that must make this item fail. A checker may ignore it; the fixture's own --mutations run verifies it.
format.synthetic: Every result computed for this fixture is synthetic (market-data Ruling 4.8).

mutation_catalog.M-B1: benchmark not translated into R (native levels)
mutation_catalog.M-B2: benchmark translated at the previous calendar day's fixing, not the portfolio's u(g)
mutation_catalog.M-B3: beta and R-squared from the excess-return regression instead of the total-return market model
mutation_catalog.M-B5: tracking error with divisor n instead of n - 1
mutation_catalog.M-B7: window facts (active and benchmark return) read the benchmark at every grid date, not only g_0 and g_n
mutation_catalog.M-B8: information ratio = window active return / tracking error
mutation_catalog.M-B9: a BANK_DISCOUNT quote read as a simple yield on ACT/360
mutation_catalog.M-B10: the FIRST selection record of the pinned log version is used instead of the latest
mutation_catalog.M-B11: the seam test ignores the ECB fixing (exchange calendars only)
mutation_catalog.M-B13: an empty portfolio instant set (cash in R only) counts as a seam
mutation_catalog.M-B14: beta = S_rb / S_rr (regression the wrong way round)
mutation_catalog.M-B15: R-squared adjusted for degrees of freedom
mutation_catalog.M-B16: alpha = A * (mean(r) - beta * mean(b)) (market-model intercept, no risk-free rate)
mutation_catalog.M-B17: the USD risk-free series used for any reporting currency
mutation_catalog.M-B19: benchmark staleness does not degrade the state
mutation_catalog.M-B20: a missing benchmark suppresses every metric, benchmark-independent ones included
mutation_catalog.M-B21: R-squared reported as 0 when the portfolio's variance is 0 (instead of undefined)
mutation_catalog.M-B22: with no selection in force, the engine defaults to the first benchmark in M
mutation_catalog.M-B23: the benchmark leg of a window fact measured from the requested base B instead of g_0

market_data.how_to_load: As cp4_golden part 1: the loader EXPANDS these compact definitions into synthetic files in the real layouts (calendars with explicit date lists, an ECB-layout EUR quote file, RAW price files, risk-free quote files with their RATE_PUBLICATIONS calendars) plus, new in part 2, one BenchmarkSeries file per benchmark (risk Ruling 5.1), all with upstream 'synthetic' and synthetic: true, in one release M. 'SYN4_BM_ABSENT' is deliberately NOT in M. The expansion introduces no number that is not in this block.

portfolios.name: Q1 (USD; one US listing on a 4-week cycle; against the US total-return index)

assertions.purpose: 1Y weekly against the US total-return index (52 observations = 13 four-week cycles): every benchmark-relative metric, LIMITED by count; same calendar and currency on both legs, so comparability FULL. The rate is constant, so alpha equals the excess-return intercept (metamorphic #7). The window facts use base 2025-01-08 (a Wednesday), so g_0 = 2025-01-10 and the cycle is not closed.
3Y weekly (39 cycles): AVAILABLE. Beta, R-squared and alpha equal Q1-B1's exactly (they are ratios of cycle sums); TE and IR differ through n - 1.
A window fact whose END benchmark level is 2 calculation days stale (gap 2026-01-15/16): LIMITED + STALE_DATA, the level of 01-14 used, and LAGGED comparability at 01-16 (portfolio 0, benchmark 2).
The same stale level is now an INTERIOR grid date of the window: a window fact reads the benchmark at g_0 and g_n only (Ruling 6.9 as of 1.1), so the active return is AVAILABLE and FULL.
End level 5 calculation days stale (gap 2026-02-23..27): INSUFFICIENT_DATA + STALE_DATA.

Unavailable benchmark, form 1b: the selection was CLEARED (record 2). Benchmark-dependent metrics: MISSING_BENCHMARK, NO_BENCHMARK_SELECTED. Volatility does not depend on the benchmark and is unaffected.
Unavailable benchmark, form 2: the selected id has no series in M (BENCHMARK_SERIES_UNAVAILABLE).
Unavailable benchmark, form 3: a PRICE_RETURN series is refused as MISSING_BENCHMARK, BENCHMARK_NOT_TOTAL_RETURN (Ruling 5.4), though its levels are those of the total-return index.
Unavailable benchmark, form 4: a total-return series first published 2025-07-04 does not cover the 1Y window (BENCHMARK_NOT_COVERING_WINDOW); a window from 2025-07-11 is covered.

portfolios.name: Q2 (USD reporting; one HK listing received in kind; HK index (HKD) then US index)

assertions.purpose: A foreign-currency benchmark (HKD) translated into USD at the SAME ECB fixing as the portfolio: the HK holding has the index's local returns, so in USD the two series are identical: beta 1, R-squared 1, alpha 0, TE 0, IR undefined (ZERO_TRACKING_ERROR), active return 0 (metamorphic #6). Both legs on SYN4_HKEX and the ECB fixing: FULL.

The selection changed (record 2): the same portfolio against the US index. HKEX close and ECB fixing against the NYSE close: SEAM, 770 minutes at 2026-01-02 (08:10 UTC against 21:00 UTC). Results name selection 2.

portfolios.name: Q4 (USD; cash only) against the US index

assertions.purpose: Cash-only against a benchmark (HG3): beta 0; R-squared undefined (ZERO_PORTFOLIO_VARIANCE); alpha = 52 x (-7/10000); TE = the benchmark's own volatility; active return = minus the benchmark return. The portfolio leg has no market instant: FULL, not SEAM (Ruling 8.2 as of 1.1).
Unavailable benchmark, form 1a: no selection record in force at all: MISSING_BENCHMARK, NO_BENCHMARK_SELECTED.

portfolios.name: Q5 (HKD reporting; one HK listing; HK index; HKD bank-discount risk-free rate)

assertions.purpose: HKD reporting with a BANK_DISCOUNT risk-free series whose quote changes on 2025-07-01: alpha uses the varying rate (so the excess-return slope would differ from beta). Both legs on SYN4_HKEX, no FX: FULL.
The bank-discount conversion (Ruling 4.3): rho = d / (360 - d t), t = 91, at the quote of each period's start; periods starting 06-20 and 06-27 at 3.60 %, 07-04 and 07-11 at 5.40 %.

portfolios.name: Q6 (USD; the US listing plus HKD cash) against the US index

assertions.purpose: Same exchange calendar on both legs, but the portfolio leg is also translated at the ECB fixing (HKD cash): SEAM through the fixing alone, 470 minutes at 2026-01-02 (13:10 UTC against 21:00 UTC).

structural_assertions.statement: Every result is synthetic; every manifest cites the convention_sets (minimum versions), the registry digest of methodology/registry/RISK_1.0_REGISTRY.json (registry_id risk/1.1), the benchmark series id and content hash, the selection_id and the pinned selection-log version (risk Rulings 5.6, 9.4).

RS-2 (Ruling 6.13): for every item with a benchmark value, the product of (1 + b_k) over the grid periods equals L_R(g_n)/L_R(g_0) exactly. RA-1: active_return = TWR(g_0, g_n] - benchmark_return exactly. RB-1: 0 <= R-squared <= 1 and beta^2 S_bb = R^2 S_rr.
Metamorphic #6 (Q2-T1): the benchmark's translated returns equal the portfolio's on every period, so beta = 1, R-squared = 1, alpha = 0, TE = 0, IR undefined, active return 0, v_beta = 0.

Metamorphic #7 (Q1, constant 3.65 % rate): mutation M-B3 (excess-return regression) changes NO item of Q1 (alpha equals the excess-return intercept when the rate is constant), while it does change Q5-H1 (varying HKD rate).

Recompute on change (UAT-03): Q2-T1 and Q2-T2 are the same portfolio, window and as_of under selection versions 1 and 2; every two-leg result names the selection it used, and none computed under version 1 is current under version 2.
Determinism: byte-identical canonical results across runs and PYTHONHASHSEED values.
